name: kmacmcfarlane
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for Kyle McFarlane — dev tooling and reusable skills.

plugins.name: kit-dev
plugins.description: Maintainer tooling for this plugin ecosystem — skill creation, project scaffolding, upstream kit sync, and factoring analysis (external: the claude-templates repo, which scaffolding reads, and the claude-templates, claude-sandbox and claude-expertise repos, which upstream sync writes; soft dependencies: create-repo, which new-project-from-template points at for a bare repo with a session launched on it; work-items, whose skill factor-analysis uses to file the agreed shape as work items, and without which the items land as a checklist in the analysis; dev-flow, whose investigate format factor-analysis writes its plan in for implement to consume, and without which the plan is a plain plan file).

plugins.name: context-guard
plugins.description: Context survival for long sessions — depth gate, checkpoint workflow, session rehydration, and token-spend reporting from the local transcripts (soft dependency: statusline-hub, for exact depth from the sensor record it writes, and the weekly reading for usage-report's share of a week; installing statusline brings it; soft dependency: work-items, whose wi the checkpoint uses to fill items: and write open-item residue when a store exists, skipping both with none).

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Always-on status line — context left (the session's and each sub-agent's, in the agent panel), plan usage limits, model and session name at a glance (requires statusline-hub: the footer draws as one of its display hooks; optional: works with context-guard, which adds its epoch and checkpoint thresholds to the gauge).

plugins.name: statusline-hub
plugins.description: The status-line slot, shared — the hub owns the statusLine command (taking a free slot on the first session, never another tool's without consent), records the context depth and plan usage Claude Code hands the status line into the sensor record other tools read, then runs the display and record hooks other plugins register; where another renderer keeps the slot, its tee command feeds the same record from a ccstatusline Custom Command, a Starship custom module, or a wrapper around your own command. (Soft dependency: statusline — its footer is the hub's first display hook; the hub takes over a slot an earlier statusline version installed once that footer has registered.)

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Plan-first development for agent sessions — investigation series, reviewed plans, verified implementation, a sub-agent dev cycle that carries one change from plan to merge (with eleven role agents, each pinned to one model at one effort: scribe, scout, implementer, implementer-critical, implementer-deep, planner, planner-deep, reviewer, reviewer-light, cross-checker, cross-checker-deep), multi-agent research fan-outs, a research skill family for sourced, verified findings and a curated knowledge base (with the research-lane, research-lane-deep and research-verifier agents, routed by the research skill's own profiles), chain-of-verification fact-checking, a foundation session that lays a new project's requirements, architecture and phased plan behind review gates, and a standing librarian that takes custody of a repo's work: files, dispatches, reviews and lands (soft dependencies: work-items, without which librarian-mode stops at start with the install command, and on which research runs record their dispatches and a foundation run its holds and features; statusline-hub, whose sensor record gives rate-limit reset times, the quota sense's usage and the research skills' quota; claude-analytics (external), whose sampler sink ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR}/claude-analytics/samples/ the quota sense reads as usage history; context-guard, for checkpoint, the context gate's advisories and rehydration, without which librarian-mode says so in each conversation's first summary (no checkpoint, no gate) and keeps the store's handoffs current at each idle turn and landing, and its usage-report, which reads item spend; kit-dev, whose update-kit takes retrospective findings; create-repo, which investigate and foundation point to when the target repo does not exist yet; sandbox, whose skill investigate and deep-investigation point to for container mounts and sidecar commits; operator-interaction, whose decisions skill librarian-mode, dev-cycle, foundation and the research skills follow to put decisions to the operator, and whose plain-names skill librarian-mode's and dev-cycle's Reports follow, when it is installed).

plugins.name: work-items
plugins.description: Repo-durable work items for humans and agents — the wi CLI over one-markdown-file-per-item stores (including a read-only cross-repo sweep with an on-demand review skill over it), and the work-source provider interface (soft dependencies: statusline-hub, whose sensor record gives the review its quota line; operator-interaction, whose decisions skill the review follows when it puts a decision to the operator, and whose plain-names skill it names items by).

plugins.name: chat
plugins.description: Conversational skills — structured product research and purchase recommendations.

plugins.name: sandbox
plugins.description: Isolated execution for Claude Code sessions — configure, bootstrap and troubleshoot claude-sandbox containers, with the checkout/worktree convention their launcher follows enforced by a PreToolUse guard.

plugins.name: create-repo
plugins.description: Start a new repo for a thread of work — the directory, git init, a README naming its purpose, claude-sandbox init and a first commit — then one copy-paste command that launches an agent session on it to write its CLAUDE.md and run the thread's first investigation (external: the claude-sandbox tool, degrading to a plain claude launch without it; soft dependencies: kit-dev, to scaffold a claude-templates template as the goal; sandbox, to troubleshoot a failed init or launch; dev-flow, whose investigate skill the launched session uses for the first investigation when installed, else it investigates directly).

plugins.name: operator-interaction
plugins.description: The agent–operator interface — how your agents put what they need from you in front of you so you can act on it where it appears. The decisions skill puts a decision to you so you can understand and answer it where it is shown: a content floor every decision carries, its impact shown in every view, detail that scales with the stakes, a set order, natural-language replies with an echo, and "decide later" with a wake. The plain-names skill names everything they mention (work items, branches, commits) in plain words, with an id only as a trailing tag. The decision-page skill puts a set of decisions on a page you answer by clicking, saved as you go, and reads your answers back for the agent to record (external, soft: claude.ai Artifacts with the db capability; a docs connector or chat without them).

plugins.name: ralph
plugins.description: Unattended agent loops over a backlog — the backlog.yaml workflow for ralph runs. Requires the claude-sandbox tool (see the sandbox plugin); consumes a work source through the work-source interface, with backlog.yaml as the default provider (soft dependency: work-items, whose work-source provider interface it implements).
